QUESTION: Will Ned join as CTO on signed 50/50 terms?

CONTEXT: Lithuanian tutoring management SaaS (tutlio.lt). Founder vibe-coded ~37k lines solo. Claims ~€1k MRR from contracts (Stripe is LIVE, sk_live_ key confirmed). Two signed clients:
- 'Mokslo vaisiai': €200 one-time + €8/month/tutor + €49/month/admin (contract next week)
- 'Visi laisvi': 1% turnover + €500 one-time + €50/month (contract this week)

DYNAMIC: Clean builder+seller split — founder does all sales/client/business, Ned does all tech. Part-time for Ned, one of ~5 projects. Highest near-term revenue potential of current projects.

NED'S PROPOSAL: 50/50 equity, signed day 1, conditional buyback agreement — leaving party sells back at contribution price (near zero). Cliff kicks in ~May after April sprint.

FOUNDER'S POSITION: Refused to sign anything. Wants 1 month trial to 'see how it fits'. Vibes are good, not bad-intentioned — just scared of signing with someone he just met.

CURRENT STATE: Working trial period. Building features from founder's list. April is peak tutoring season — window to onboard real clients. Summer is slow.

BLOCKERS: No signed agreement. Risk is Ned builds value for free. Mitigation: capping hours, keeping architecture/security fixes locked behind signed deal.
